description: Typhoeus, Arcane, Liino, Perlica (2026-11-16; re-found by efsim rules --guided under the objective across starts, 2026-11-22). Liino's, Arcane's and Typhoeus's ultimates only while Typhoeus hovers; Typhoeus's ultimate also when Arcane's gauge is below half; Typhoeus's combo while hovering, or on the ground after Perlica's ultimate; Perlica's and Arcane's combos when lit; while the enemy's Stagger bar is below half, Arcane's battle skill, then Liino's battle skill only if her button shows it (never End Stance); Typhoeus takes flight (battle skill) and uses her combo whenever she's on the ground. Against the list before, 32 fresh seeds (1001–1032, 300 s, 0.3 s reaction), the objective across starts (the mean of full energy and from zero per seed): +8.62% ± 0.65 (full energy +7.85% ± 0.76, 52,949 → 57,103; from zero +9.44% ± 1.08, 50,194 → 54,932).
